import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables, ignoring the first numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename columns in source0 to match target schema suffix _15
df_source0_renamed = df_source0.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Rename 'Family' and 'Freedom' columns to have _15 suffix to match target schema
df_source0_renamed = df_source0_renamed.rename(columns={
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15'
})

# Select and reorder columns from source0 to match target schema columns for _15 suffix
df_source0_selected = df_source0_renamed[[
    'Country',
    'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15',
    'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom_15',
    'Trust_15',
    'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia_15'
]]

# For source1, columns mostly match target schema suffix _17, just ensure correct order and presence
df_source1_selected = df_source1[[
    'Country',
    'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17',
    'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17'
]]

# Join the two source tables on 'Country' (inner join to keep only countries present in both)
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0_selected, df_source1_selected, on='Country', how='inner')

# The target schema expects 'Region' from source0, so keep it as is

# Reorder columns to exactly match the target schema order
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_target = df_joined[target_columns]

# Convert columns to correct data types as per target schema

# String columns
df_target['Country'] = df_target['Country'].astype(str)
df_target['Region'] = df_target['Region'].astype(str)

# Integer columns
int_columns = ['Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Rank_17']
for col in int_columns:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Float columns
float_columns = [
    'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17', 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]
for col in float_columns:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

# Output path for the transformed target table
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/target_multisource.csv"

# Save the transformed dataframe to CSV without the index
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
